verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe pre-filtering an exact candidate set via graph traversal before vector ranking, plus vector indexes with distance metrics, search/filtering on nodes and edges, and text/BM25 indexes that can combine with vector search — supporting metadata-constrained vector search. However there is no benchmark or independent evidence quantifying recall/latency impact of filtering, and community comments raise concerns about performance on multi-hop queries and small benchmark datasets, which is adjacent but not a direct contradiction of filtered-vector-search quality. missing for 10: quantified recall/latency benchmarks specifically for filtered vector search, independent hands-on validation that filtering doesn't degrade recall/latency.
